blogPosts.title: How Much Does Custom Joinery Cost in Frankston in 2026?
blogPosts.excerpt: Discover the real costs of custom joinery in Frankston, from kitchen cabinetry to built-in wardrobes. We break down pricing, materials, and what affects your quote.
body: If you are a homeowner in Frankston or the surrounding Mornington Peninsula suburbs, you have probably wondered how much custom joinery actually costs. The truth is, prices vary significantly depending on the type of project, the materials selected, and the complexity of the design. A simple set of built-in shelves might start from around $800, while a complete custom kitchen fit-out in a Frankston family home could range from $8,000 to $25,000 or more. At Divine Joinery, we believe in transparent pricing, which is why every quote we provide for Frankston clients includes a full breakdown of design, materials, manufacturing, and installation costs with no hidden extras.

Several key factors influence the cost of custom joinery in the Frankston area. The first is material selection. Engineered timber products like MDF and particleboard are more affordable upfront, while solid hardwoods such as Victorian ash, blackbutt, or spotted gum carry a premium but offer superior longevity and a stunning natural finish. The second factor is design complexity. Straightforward rectangular cabinetry is quicker to manufacture than curved panels, soft-close drawer systems, or integrated lighting. Frankston homes with unusual room shapes or older construction often require additional measurement and custom templating, which affects both the timeline and the overall investment.

For kitchen joinery, which remains the most popular custom project across the Mornington Peninsula, expect to pay between $5,000 and $15,000 for a mid-range renovation that includes new cabinetry, benchtop preparation, and hardware. Premium kitchen projects in Frankston with stone benchtops, waterfall edges, and custom pantry storage can easily exceed $20,000. The key to keeping costs manageable is working with an experienced joiner like Divine Joinery who can suggest smart material alternatives, optimise your layout for maximum storage, and avoid unnecessary complexity that drives up the price without adding real functional value to your Frankston home.

Built-in wardrobes represent another significant category of joinery work popular across Frankston and the Peninsula. A standard two-door built-in wardrobe typically starts from $1,500 to $2,500, while walk-in robe fit-outs with custom shelving, drawers, and mirror panels can range from $3,000 to $7,000. The cost depends heavily on the available wall space, the internal configuration you require, and whether the wardrobe needs to accommodate sloped ceilings or integrate with existing room architecture. Frankston townhouses and units often present unique challenges with compact spaces, making custom joinery an ideal solution that far outperforms flat-pack alternatives in both durability and visual appeal.

Commercial joinery projects in Frankston carry a different pricing structure entirely. A simple reception desk or retail display unit might start from $2,000, while full shopfit-outs for cafes, restaurants, or professional offices along the Frankston foreshore or in the central business district can range from $10,000 to $50,000 or more. Commercial projects require compliance with Australian building standards, fire ratings, and accessibility requirements that residential work does not. At Divine Joinery, we have extensive experience delivering commercial joinery across Frankston and the Mornington Peninsula, and we work closely with builders, architects, and business owners to deliver projects on time and within budget.

When budgeting for custom joinery in Frankston, it is wise to factor in additional costs that many people overlook. Delivery and logistics, particularly for larger pieces that require crane access or street permits, can add $200 to $500 to your project. Painting, staining, or lacquering finished joinery is sometimes quoted separately. If your Frankston home was built before 1990, there may be additional preparation work needed such as levelling uneven walls or removing old cabinetry before new pieces can be installed. Divine Joinery always discusses these potential extras during our initial on-site consultation in Frankston so there are no surprises when the final invoice arrives.

The best way to determine the true cost of your custom joinery project in Frankston is to book a free on-site consultation with Divine Joinery. We visit your home or business, take precise measurements, discuss your vision and functional requirements, and provide a detailed fixed-price quote typically within 48 hours. There is absolutely no obligation, and many of our Frankston clients find that our transparent approach gives them the confidence to move forward. Whether you are planning a kitchen renovation, a wardrobe upgrade, or a complete commercial fit-out on the Mornington Peninsula, contact us today to get an accurate, no-surprises quote tailored to your specific needs.

blogPosts.title: Best Timber and Materials for Kitchen Cabinets on the Mornington Peninsula
blogPosts.excerpt: Choosing the right timber and materials for your kitchen cabinets is critical in the Mornington Peninsula's coastal climate. Learn what works best for Frankston homes.
body: Choosing the right materials for your kitchen cabinets is one of the most important decisions you will make during a renovation, and it is especially critical for homeowners in Frankston and the wider Mornington Peninsula. The region's proximity to Port Phillip Bay means homes are regularly exposed to salt air, humidity fluctuations, and temperature swings between hot summers and cool winters. These coastal conditions can cause inferior materials to warp, swell, or deteriorate far more quickly than they would in an inland location. At Divine Joinery, we have spent years working with materials across the Mornington Peninsula and know exactly which products stand the test of time in Frankston's unique environment.

Solid timber remains the gold standard for premium kitchen cabinetry, and several Australian hardwoods perform exceptionally well in the Frankston climate. Victorian ash is a popular choice for its light, contemporary appearance and excellent workability. Blackbutt offers outstanding durability and natural fire resistance, making it ideal for kitchen environments. For a warmer, richer tone, spotted gum delivers beautiful grain patterns and impressive hardness that resists dents and scratches. While solid timber carries a higher upfront cost than engineered alternatives, its ability to be sanded, refinished, and repaired means a well-built Frankston kitchen can look stunning for decades.

Engineered wood products offer a more budget-friendly path to custom kitchen joinery without sacrificing quality entirely. Medium-density fibreboard, or MDF, provides a smooth, consistent surface that takes paint beautifully, making it ideal for achieving a sleek, modern kitchen finish in your Frankston home. Moisture-resistant MDF, identifiable by its green core, is specifically designed for kitchen and bathroom environments where humidity levels fluctuate. Particleboard with a laminate or melamine overlay is another cost-effective option that delivers good durability for cabinet carcasses. Divine Joinery uses engineered products strategically across Mornington Peninsula projects to optimise cost without compromising structural integrity.

Benchtop materials deserve careful consideration alongside your cabinet selections. In Frankston kitchens, you will typically choose between laminate, engineered stone such as Caesarstone or Smartstone, natural stone like marble or granite, timber butcher block, or solid surface materials like Corian. Laminate remains the most affordable option and has improved dramatically in recent years, with premium ranges offering realistic stone-look finishes. Engineered stone is the most popular mid-to-premium choice for Mornington Peninsula homes, offering exceptional stain resistance and a wide range of colours. Natural stone requires sealing and ongoing maintenance but delivers an unmatched aesthetic that many Frankston homeowners consider worth the investment.

The hardware and fittings you select for your Frankston kitchen cabinets are just as important as the timber itself. Soft-close drawer runners and hinges have become the standard expectation for quality custom joinery across the Peninsula, and for good reason, they protect your cabinetry from daily impact damage and create a premium feel. Blum and Hettich are two of the most trusted hardware brands we recommend to our Frankston clients. Pull-out pantry systems, corner carousel units, and under-sink organisational drawers can transform a basic kitchen into an extraordinarily functional space. Divine Joinery sources high-quality hardware that is specifically rated for the weight and usage demands of Mornington Peninsula kitchens.

The Mornington Peninsula's coastal climate also affects finishing products. For painted timber kitchens in Frankston, a two-pack polyurethane finish provides the most durable and moisture-resistant surface available. Water-based finishes are increasingly popular for their lower VOC emissions and faster drying times, making them ideal for occupied homes. For natural timber kitchens, a hardwax oil finish such as Osmo provides excellent protection while allowing the wood grain to breathe and develop a beautiful patina over time. Divine Joinery always recommends finishing products that are specifically suited to the Frankston environment, ensuring your kitchen cabinets maintain their appearance and structural integrity for years to come.

Selecting the right materials for your Frankston kitchen project is a decision that benefits enormously from expert guidance. At Divine Joinery, we bring material samples to your initial consultation so you can see, touch, and compare different timbers, laminates, and benchtop options in your actual kitchen space, under your home's natural lighting conditions. This hands-on approach helps our Mornington Peninsula clients make informed decisions that balance aesthetics, durability, and budget. Contact us today to arrange a free design consultation at your Frankston home and let us help you choose the perfect materials for kitchen cabinets that will look exceptional and perform beautifully for years.

blogPosts.title: Why Custom Built-In Wardrobes Add Value to Your Frankston Home
blogPosts.excerpt: Custom built-in wardrobes are one of the smartest investments for Frankston homeowners. Discover how they boost storage, lifestyle appeal, and property value.
body: For homeowners in Frankston and the surrounding Mornington Peninsula suburbs, custom built-in wardrobes represent one of the most practical and value-adding investments you can make in your property. Unlike freestanding wardrobes that waste vertical space and create awkward gaps, custom built-in solutions are designed to fit your bedroom dimensions precisely, transforming unused wall space into highly organised storage. In the competitive Frankston property market, homes with well-designed built-in storage consistently attract stronger buyer interest and higher sale prices. Divine Joinery has designed and installed hundreds of custom wardrobes across the Peninsula, and we have seen first-hand how the right storage solution transforms both daily living and long-term property value.

The primary advantage of custom built-in wardrobes for Frankston homes is the ability to maximise every centimetre of available space. Bedrooms in older Frankston houses often feature sloped ceilings, uneven walls, or unusual alcoves that make standard wardrobes impractical. A custom joinery solution from Divine Joinery can incorporate angled rooflines, wrap around existing architectural features, and include specialised storage for shoes, accessories, folded clothing, and hanging garments all within a single cohesive unit. This level of optimisation is simply impossible with off-the-shelf solutions, and it is particularly valuable in compact Frankston townhouses and units where efficient storage design makes a meaningful difference to liveability.

Material selection plays a critical role in the longevity and appearance of your Frankston built-in wardrobe. At Divine Joinery, we typically recommend moisture-resistant MDF or solid timber construction for bedroom joinery across the Mornington Peninsula. While MDF provides an excellent surface for painted finishes that match your bedroom decor, solid timber options like Victorian ash or pine offer a natural warmth that many Frankston homeowners prefer. The internal configuration can include a mix of hanging rails at different heights, adjustable shelving, pull-out drawers, and dedicated accessory compartments. We also frequently incorporate LED strip lighting and full-length mirrors into our Frankston wardrobe designs, adding both functionality and a sense of spaciousness to the room.

The installation process for custom built-in wardrobes in Frankston is surprisingly efficient when handled by experienced professionals. Divine Joinery typically completes the manufacturing of your wardrobe components in our workshop, which minimises disruption to your home. On-site installation usually takes one to two days depending on the complexity and scale of the project. We take precise measurements during our initial Frankston consultation to ensure every panel, shelf, and drawer fits perfectly, eliminating the gaps and misalignments that plague flat-pack alternatives. Our installation team works cleanly and respectfully, and your new wardrobe is fully functional and ready to use from the moment we finish.

From a property value perspective, custom built-in wardrobes consistently rank among the top improvements that Frankston buyers look for during inspections. Real estate agents across the Mornington Peninsula report that bedrooms with quality built-in storage are perceived as significantly more desirable than those with freestanding furniture or empty walls. The return on investment for custom wardrobe joinery in Frankston typically ranges from 75% to over 100% at resale, making it one of the most cost-effective home improvements available. For investors with rental properties in the Frankston area, custom wardrobes also help attract higher-quality tenants and justify premium rental rates.

Beyond bedrooms, Divine Joinery designs custom built-in storage solutions for hallways, laundries, and living areas across Frankston homes. Hallway linen cupboards with custom shelving and drawer configurations transform cluttered passages into organised, attractive spaces. Custom laundry cabinetry with integrated benchtops and washing machine housings are increasingly popular in Frankston renovations, where maximising utility in compact spaces is essential. Living room built-in entertainment units and bookshelves provide both storage and a stunning focal point that elevates the entire room. Each of these solutions adds tangible value to your Frankston property while making your daily life more organised and enjoyable.

If you are considering custom built-in wardrobes for your Frankston or Mornington Peninsula home, the first step is a free on-site consultation with Divine Joinery. We visit your property, assess the available space, discuss your storage requirements and style preferences, and provide a detailed quote with a clear timeline. Our design process is collaborative, and we encourage our Frankston clients to share inspiration images and ideas so the final result perfectly reflects their vision. Whether you need a single wardrobe or a complete home storage solution, Divine Joinery has the expertise and experience to deliver exceptional results. Contact us today to schedule your free Frankston consultation.

blogPosts.title: Planning a Commercial Fit-Out in Frankston? Here Is Your Complete Guide
blogPosts.excerpt: Everything Frankston business owners need to know about commercial joinery fit-outs, from planning and compliance to materials, timelines, and costs.
body: Opening or renovating a commercial space in Frankston is an exciting venture, and the quality of your joinery fit-out can make or break the customer experience. Whether you are launching a cafe on the Frankston foreshore, fitting out a professional office in the central business district, or renovating a retail store along Nepean Highway, custom commercial joinery defines how your space looks, feels, and functions. Divine Joinery has extensive experience delivering commercial fit-out projects across Frankston and the wider Mornington Peninsula, and this guide covers everything local business owners need to know about planning, budgeting, and executing a successful commercial joinery project.

The first step in any Frankston commercial fit-out is understanding the regulatory requirements that apply to your specific business type and location. Commercial joinery must comply with Australian Building Code requirements, including fire ratings for materials used in public spaces, accessibility standards under the Disability Discrimination Act, and any specific requirements mandated by the Frankston City Council or your shopping centre landlord. Divine Joinery works closely with Frankston business owners, builders, and architects to ensure every piece of commercial joinery meets or exceeds these requirements. We maintain current knowledge of the standards that apply to hospitality, retail, and professional service fit-outs across the Mornington Peninsula.

Material selection for commercial joinery in Frankston differs significantly from residential projects. Commercial environments experience far heavier daily use, so durability and ease of maintenance are paramount. High-pressure laminate surfaces from brands like Polytec and Laminex are the standard choice for Frankston commercial benchtops and cabinetry because they resist scratches, stains, and impact while offering hundreds of colour and finish options. For cafes and restaurants along the Frankston waterfront, we often recommend solid timber bar tops and service counters that develop character over time while maintaining structural integrity. All materials used in our Frankston commercial fit-outs are selected for their compliance with relevant Australian standards and their ability to withstand the demands of a busy commercial environment.

Planning the layout and workflow of your Frankston commercial space is where Divine Joinery's design expertise truly adds value. A successful cafe fit-out, for example, requires joinery that supports efficient barista workflow, provides adequate customer seating, includes proper storage for supplies, and creates an inviting atmosphere that encourages repeat visits. Our team visits your Frankston site, discusses your operational requirements, and develops detailed shop drawings that optimise every aspect of the space. We have completed commercial joinery projects for cafes, restaurants, medical practices, retail shops, and professional offices across the Mornington Peninsula, giving us deep insight into what works for each business type.

Budgeting for a commercial joinery fit-out in Frankston requires careful planning, and costs can vary enormously depending on the scale and complexity of the project. A basic retail display and counter fit-out might start from $5,000 to $10,000, while a full cafe or restaurant fit-out with custom bar, servery, kitchen cabinetry, and customer seating joinery typically ranges from $15,000 to $40,000. Professional office fit-outs including reception desks, workstation cabinetry, and meeting room built-ins generally fall between $8,000 and $25,000. Divine Joinery provides detailed, fixed-price quotes for every Frankston commercial project, breaking down costs by design, materials, manufacturing, and installation so you can make informed decisions about where to invest and where to economise.

Timeline management is critical for commercial fit-outs in Frankston because every week of delayed opening represents lost revenue for your business. Divine Joinery typically structures commercial projects with a clear manufacturing phase conducted off-site at our workshop, followed by efficient on-site installation that minimises disruption. A standard cafe fit-out in Frankston usually requires four to six weeks from design approval to completion, while larger projects may need eight to twelve weeks. We coordinate closely with your builders, electricians, and other trades to ensure the joinery phase integrates seamlessly into the overall construction schedule. Our Frankston commercial clients consistently praise our ability to deliver on time and keep their projects on track.

After installation, Divine Joinery provides ongoing support for our Frankston commercial clients to ensure their joinery continues to perform at its best. Commercial environments experience wear and tear that residential spaces do not, and we offer maintenance services including touch-up repairs, hinge and runner replacements, and surface refinishing to keep your Frankston business looking professional and inviting. We also stand behind every commercial project with our workmanship guarantee, giving you complete peace of mind that your investment is protected. If you are planning a commercial fit-out in Frankston or anywhere on the Mornington Peninsula, contact Divine Joinery today to discuss your project and receive a detailed, no-obligation quote.
